chunks: But if he is of the deniers and the errants,

key_terms.الضَّالِّينَ: The errants, those who are astray or deviated
key_terms.الْمُكَذِّبِينَ: The deniers, those who reject the truth

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'deniers and errants' mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the dual spiritual affliction of the disbelievers: intellectual denial (takdhib) coupled with moral deviation (dalal), often linked to the concept of *fitrah* being obscured. It serves as a precise descriptor for those who reject the Imamate or Prophethood not merely out of ignorance, but through active stubbornness, setting the stage for their specific recompense in the Hereafter.
